description: Round-3 Phase 1 — first-section playback (issue #3 regression guard). One break at timeline frame 300; a clip occupies frames 0..29 entirely inside the first section, ending well before the break. Hit Play from frame 0. The clip must be active and the playhead must advance normally — no Phase 5 visibility-gate misfire even though m_atSectionBreak might transiently get set during the test session. Pre-fix: when sectionAtBreak() got stuck true after an earlier interaction, clips with startFrame ≈ break frame would be hidden; this test pins the simpler case where the clip is nowhere near the break and SHOULD always play. Together with scrub_clears_at_break.json this covers both the bad state path and the basic invariant. CI-robustness notes: the break sits at 300 (10 s of playback away) so a slow runner cannot cross it and park before the asserts run — the original break at 60 was crossed on WARP CI runners, turning the Playing assert into a Paused observation. WaitUntilPlayheadAtLeast replaces WaitFrames 30, proving actual playhead advance at any machine speed.
